title: MZT Skopje earn 12th Prva Liga title
description: TFT - MZT Skopje 53-77 MZT Skopje have been crowned Prva Liga champions. They upset TFT on the road in Game 4 to clinch the 12th League trophy. The game was mostly controlled by MZT Skopje. TFT managed to win third quarter 18-15. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. MZT Skopje dominated down low during the game scoring 44 of its points in the paint compared to TFT's 24 and made 21-of-27 free shots (77.8 percent) during the game. They outrebounded TFT 42-31 including a 33-21 advantage in defensive rebounds. 25 personal fouls committed by TFT helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. The former international swingman Vojdan Stojanovski (194-1987) fired 17 points and 4 assists for the winners.
